# @noble/ciphers 2.4.0 (subset)

Unmodified files from the npm package `@noble/ciphers@2.4.0`
(`https://registry.npmjs.org/@noble/ciphers/-/ciphers-2.4.0.tgz`, integrity
`sha512-AnjFn0Jv92laAkvMrghlFZq4qQCIN/4DxFV/eooqtC2YTjB7kBeLMS2T9KJX4Dn+ZVXLOwK0lSgqDtx9gvxtiw==`):
`chacha.js`, `_arx.js`, `_poly1305.js`, `utils.js` and `LICENSE` (MIT).

Along uses only `xchacha20poly1305`, the payload cipher required by the current
R2 FORMATS 4.1 (provisional). WebCrypto does not provide it. See
`experiments/r2-current/README.md`.
